inputs.text:
### Pipeline 1: Start & End Keyframe Generator (Pre-Render Review Gate)
**Purpose:** Creates your opening **Start Frame** (and optional identity-anchored **End Frame**) *before* committing GPU time to Wan 2.2 video generation.

- **Nodes 1–11 (Start Frame Branch):** Uses `FLUX.1-dev` + your private Character FLUX LoRA (`0.85` recommended) to compose lighting, framing, wardrobe, and character likeness.
- **Nodes 12–20 (Anchored End Frame Branch):** Uses `FLUX.1-Kontext-dev` + `ReferenceLatent` (Node 16) to lock the room, lighting, and face from the Start Frame while evolving the pose/expression to your final beat.
- **Safe to Tweak:** Node `5` (Start Prompt), Node `15` (End Prompt), Node `4`/`13` (`strength_model` 0.75–0.90), Node `6`/`17` (`guidance` 2.5–3.5), and Seeds (`9`, `18`).

_meta.title: 📖 READ FIRST — Pipeline 1: Start & End Keyframe Gate
_meta.description: Overview sticky note rendered as a yellow Markdown card in ComfyUI and stripped automatically before headless API execution.

_meta.title: [1] Load FLUX.1-dev (Start Frame Base Model)
_meta.description: Loads the FP8-quantized FLUX.1-dev diffusion transformer used to render the opening keyframe.

_meta.title: [2] Load FLUX DualCLIP (CLIP-L + T5-XXL)
_meta.description: Shared text encoders for both Start (FLUX.1-dev) and End (FLUX.1-Kontext-dev) branches.

_meta.title: [3] Load FLUX Autoencoder (VAE)
_meta.description: Encodes and decodes 16-channel FLUX image latents to RGB pixels.

_meta.title: [4] Character Identity LoRA (Start Frame — 0.85)
_meta.description: Injects your private character FLUX LoRA from ephemeral RAM (/dev/shm). Keep strength around 0.80–0.90 for natural skin texture.

inputs.text: cinematic medium shot of character in warm golden hour light, 35mm film grain

_meta.title: [5] Start Frame Positive Prompt (Include Trigger Word)
_meta.description: Describe camera framing, lighting, environment, wardrobe, and opening expression. Include your character trigger word (e.g., 'dleston man').

_meta.title: [6] Start Frame FLUX Guidance (3.5)
_meta.description: Controls prompt adherence for FLUX.1-dev. Lower (2.5–3.0) feels more photographic; higher (3.5–4.0) follows complex staging more strictly.

inputs.text: blurry, deformed hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, watermark

_meta.title: [7] Negative Prompt Baseline
_meta.description: Baseline negative conditioning entry (FLUX uses cfg=1.0 by default, so positive phrasing in Node 5 has the strongest effect).

_meta.title: [8] Keyframe Canvas Resolution (1280x720 16:9)
_meta.description: Sets the widescreen 720p aspect ratio matching Wan 2.2 14B native HD video generation.

_meta.title: [9] Sample Start Keyframe (24 Steps, Euler/Simple)
_meta.description: Generates the Start Frame latent. Change 'seed' to re-roll composition while keeping the same prompt.

_meta.title: [10] Decode Start Keyframe Pixels
_meta.description: Converts the sampled Start Frame latent into an RGB image.

_meta.title: [11] Save Start Frame (Sent to Director Studio)
_meta.description: Writes start_frame.png into ephemeral scratch so Director Studio can display it in the Keyframes review gate.

inputs.text:
### Kontext-Anchored End Frame (Nodes 12–20)
Why not generate the End Frame from scratch? Independent T2I generations drift in background geometry, wardrobe, and lighting.

Instead, **Node 14 + Node 16 (`ReferenceLatent`)** feed the decoded Start Frame directly into **`FLUX.1-Kontext-dev`**, instructing it to keep the exact same scene and person while changing only the pose, camera angle, or expression described in **Node 15**.

_meta.title: 🔗 HOW END-FRAME ANCHORING WORKS (FLUX Kontext)
_meta.description: Explains why ReferenceLatent + FLUX.1-Kontext-dev prevents scene and wardrobe drift between Start and End frames.

_meta.title: [12] Load FLUX.1-Kontext-dev (Scene-Consistent Editor)
_meta.description: Context-aware FLUX model specialized in editing pose/action while preserving the reference image's environment and subject.

_meta.title: [13] Character Identity LoRA (End Frame Kontext — 0.85)
_meta.description: Reinforces facial identity on the End Frame even if the character turns their head or changes expression.

_meta.title: [14] Re-Encode Start Frame as Kontext Reference
_meta.description: Encodes the newly generated Start Frame pixels into latent space to anchor the End Frame.

inputs.text: same character and room lighting, turning slowly toward the doorway, determined gaze

_meta.title: [15] End Frame Target Pose / Expression Prompt
_meta.description: Describe where the character and camera should end up at the end of the shot (e.g., 'same lighting, looking up with a subtle smile').

_meta.title: [16] Bind Start Frame Reference to End Conditioning
_meta.description: Locks the Start Frame's scene context onto the End Frame's text prompt.

_meta.title: [17] End Frame Kontext Guidance (2.5)
_meta.description: Slightly gentler guidance (2.5) keeps Kontext faithful to the Start Frame's room and lighting while applying the pose change.

_meta.title: [18] Sample Anchored End Keyframe (20 Steps)
_meta.description: Samples the target End Frame. Re-rolling this seed explores different landing poses without changing your approved Start Frame.

_meta.title: [19] Decode End Keyframe Pixels
_meta.description: Converts the sampled End Frame latent into an RGB image.

_meta.title: [20] Save End Frame (Sent to Director Studio)
_meta.description: Writes end_frame.png into ephemeral scratch for side-by-side comparison in Director Studio.
